description:
Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl, its copybooks, its BMS symbolic map and the shipped ASCII fixtures. It was NOT captured from, recorded against, or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment (no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID/DFHBMSCA/DFHATTR are absent from the repository). That substitutes the PROVENANCE of the expected values and nothing else - see AAP 0.7.6 and risk R-A, where the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than silently absorbed. review_rules returns exactly one line, "No user rules provided", so no user-specified Rule governs this file; enterprise best practice governs instead and the absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar.

WHAT THIS CASE OWNS: all five COMPUTE statements in COACTUPC - the only five the program contains - on their conforming path, driven by five deliberately different input shapes. THESE ARE NOT BUSINESS CALCULATIONS. Each one is a PARSE of fifteen bytes of screen text into a twelve-byte signed span, guarded by FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C: no rate is applied, no balance is accumulated, and no amount is derived from another amount. Reading them as arithmetic is the most likely way to mistranslate them, so the folder-level shorthand "credit-limit and balance computations" is corrected here from the source itself. Gates G23 and G28 belong to this case.

THE FIVE SITES, AS WRITTEN, WITH THEIR OPERANDS. :1079-1080 COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CREDIT-LIMIT-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(ACRDLIMI OF CACTUPAI). :1093-1094 COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(ACSHLIMI OF CACTUPAI). :1107-1108 COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL-X). :1121-1122 COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(ACRCYCRI OF CACTUPAI). :1135-1136 COMPUTE ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-N = FUNCTION NUMVAL-C(ACRCYDBI OF CACTUPAI). FOUR of the five convert the MAP FIELD and exactly one - the current balance at :1107-1108 - converts the STAGING COPY, while the TEST-NUMVAL-C guard at :1078, :1092, :1106, :1120 and :1134 always reads the staging copy. That asymmetry is transcribed as the source writes it rather than normalised into a single form. The two operands hold the same bytes here only because the MOVE immediately above each site is a width-for-width PIC X(15) to PIC X(15) copy, which is a property of these five statements and not a licence to treat the two operands as interchangeable.

THE GUARDED SHAPE, AND WHAT ITS ELSE DOES NOT DO. Each site sits inside IF <map field> = '*' OR = SPACES MOVE LOW-VALUES TO ACUP-NEW-...-X ELSE MOVE <map field> TO ACUP-NEW-...-X, IF FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL-C(ACUP-NEW-...-X) = 0 COMPUTE ... ELSE CONTINUE - the five blocks at :1073-1085, :1087-1099, :1101-1113, :1115-1127 and :1129-1141. The ELSE is CONTINUE and not an assignment, so a non-conforming value leaves the -N span holding whatever it already held; that arm, and the blank arm above it, are the subject of the validation case rather than of this one. Here all five values conform, TEST-NUMVAL-C returns 0 at every site, and all five COMPUTEs execute.

WIDTHS AND SCALE, TAKEN MECHANICALLY FROM PICTURE CLAUSES AND NEVER GUESSED. The five staging items ACUP-NEW-CREDIT-LIMIT-X, ACUP-NEW-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT-X, ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL-X, ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-CREDIT-X and ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-DEBIT-X are each PIC X(15) at :412-416, which is also the width app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY declares for ACRDLIMI, ACSHLIMI, ACURBALI, ACRCYCRI and ACRCYDBI. Each receiver is a PIC X(12) item carrying a numeric REDEFINES view at PIC S9(10)V99: ACUP-NEW-CURR-BAL / -N at :763-765, ACUP-NEW-CREDIT-LIMIT / -N at :766-768, ACUP-NEW-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT / -N at :769-771, ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-CREDIT / -N at :790-792 and ACUP-NEW-CURR-CYC-DEBIT / -N at :793-795. Ten integer digits plus two fractional digits is twelve bytes with no separate sign byte, because the sign rides as a zoned overpunch in the trailing character - { A B C D E F G H I for +0 through +9 and } J K L M N O P Q R for -0 through -9. The scale is therefore EXACTLY 2 at all five, which is gate G23, and that is not a local choice: an exhaustive scan of this codebase's signed decimal PICTURE clauses returns only V99 forms.

TRUNCATION, NOT ROUNDING - AND THIS CASE DOES NOT PROVE IT. The keyword ROUNDED appears ZERO times in COACTUPC and zero times across all twenty-eight programs, so a store into PIC S9(10)V99 discards excess fractional digits instead of rounding them. The faithful Java equivalent is BigDecimal at scale 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, routed through the module's single scale-and-rounding seam in common/CobolDecimal: never HALF_UP, never HALF_EVEN, never CEILING and never FLOOR (gate G24). This case is deliberately the one where that choice is INVISIBLE. ACSHLIMI carries a third decimal digit of 0, so 5000.000 stores as 5000.00 under every rounding mode there is, and the other four values carry exactly two decimals. An exact value proves the SCALE; only a value whose third decimal is non-zero can prove the MODE, and that is a different case. Saying so here is the point - an exact value must never be mistaken for evidence about the mode.

NO PACKED DECIMAL REACHES A RECORD, WHICH IS A MATERIAL DE-RISKING. Not one of the twenty-eight copybooks in app/cpy declares COMP-3 or PACKED-DECIMAL - verified zero - so every persisted numeric field in this system, including all five spans this case pins, is zoned DISPLAY and the fixed-width codec needs no nibble unpacking at all. COACTUPC's only packed items live in WORKING-STORAGE and are never written: WS-EDIT-ALPHANUM-LENGTH PIC S9(4) COMP-3 at :62, and WS-DIV-BY, WS-DIVIDEND and WS-REMAINDER PIC S9(4) COMP-3 at :152, :154 and :157.

REACHABILITY: THE FIVE SITES ARE POST-FETCH ONLY. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP performs INITIALIZE ACUP-NEW-DETAILS at :1047, handles the account filter at :1051-1058, and then leaves at :1060-1062 - IF ACUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED GO TO 1100-RECEIVE-MAP-EXIT - BEFORE reaching any of the five. A case in the not-fetched state could never execute them, so this one carries fetched details.

THE TURN THIS CASE MODELS, AND WHY THE PARSED VALUES BECOME OBSERVABLE BYTES. The five receivers are items of this program's own commarea extension, so nothing about them is visible until 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING stages them into a record. The turn is therefore the CONFIRMING one: the edits passed on the previous pass, so ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED - the 88 valued 'N' at :664 - arrives in the extension, and PF05 is pressed. :876 clears WS-RETURN-MSG. :905-912 admits PF05 as a valid AID only because (CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) holds at :908. The ordered EVALUATE at :921 therefore reaches WHEN OTHER at :996, which performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION and 3000-SEND-MAP in that order. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP runs, so all five COMPUTEs execute; 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS then RETURNS EARLY at :1463-1467, because ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED is one of that condition's three disjuncts. That early return is exactly why nothing is edited again on this turn, no message is composed and no field is highlighted. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION takes its :2602-2605 arm and performs 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING, and its :2613-2614 WHEN OTHER then sets ACUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE. The transaction ends at the EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID at :1015, and the return code is 0 because COACTUPC never sets one.

WHAT 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING DOES HERE, IN ORDER, FROM :3888. :3894-3903 reads ACCTDAT with UPDATE and :3907-3916 would abandon the paragraph on anything but DFHRESP(NORMAL), never touching the customer file; :3921-3930 does the same against CUSTDAT under the key CDEMO-CUST-ID supplies at :3920, guarded identically at :3934-3943. Both reads are normal here. :3947-3951 performs 9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, which compares the two records just read under the lock against ACUP-OLD-DETAILS - the snapshot 9500-STORE-FETCHED-DATA took at :3801-3813 when the screen was painted. The two seeded rows ARE that snapshot, so nothing changed underneath and the paragraph continues; the five monetary differences this case carries are between ACUP-OLD and ACUP-NEW, which 9700 does not compare. :3956 stages ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD and :4007 stages CUST-UPDATE-RECORD; :4065-4071 rewrites the account row at its full declared length and :4086 rewrites the customer row. Two writes, in that order, and this case pins both.

THE STAGED ACCOUNT IMAGE IS ACCT-UPDATE-RECORD'S LAYOUT, NOT CVACT01Y'S. The record declared at :418-433 is PIC 9(11), PIC X(01), three PIC S9(10)V99 amounts, three PIC X(10) dates, two more PIC S9(10)V99 amounts, PIC X(10) and FILLER PIC X(188) - 300 bytes, with the group identifier at offset 102 where app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy keeps ACCT-ADDR-ZIP, so CVACT01Y's own ACCT-GROUP-ID span at offset 112 falls inside the reserved area and goes out blank. That divergence is real behaviour and is reproduced here rather than repaired. AADDGRPI is not editable on this screen and arrives as ten spaces, so :1213-1215 moves LOW-VALUES into ACUP-NEW-GROUP-ID and the ten bytes at offset 102 are NUL rather than space. The FILLER is 188 spaces, ten wider than CVACT01Y's X(178), and it is emitted rather than dropped (gates G19 and G21): the pinned 300-character image is what proves both the total width and the FILLER. The three dates are the STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE compositions at :3976-3999, which join the PIC X(4) year and the two PIC X(2) parts with hyphens into a PIC X(10) receiver.

THE STAGED CUSTOMER IMAGE IS AN ECHO, AND THAT IS ALSO AN ASSERTION. CUST-UPDATE-RECORD at :434-456 carries the same layout as app/cpy/CVCUS01Y.cpy - 500 bytes ending in FILLER PIC X(168) - so no offset divergence applies on this side. 9600 rewrites the customer record on every successful path whether or not any customer item changed; there is no "only write what changed" guard anywhere in the paragraph, so the 500-byte write is behaviour in its own right and is pinned. Every customer field on this screen is the fetched value echoed back except the three named in the next paragraph, so the staged image is byte-for-byte the seeded row apart from CUST-ADDR-ZIP, CUST-PHONE-NUM-2 and CUST-FICO-CREDIT-SCORE. The two telephone numbers are the STRING compositions '(' area ')' prefix '-' line, and the date of birth is year '-' month '-' day, each landing in a PIC X(15) or PIC X(10) receiver and space-padded on the right.

WHY EVERY SCREEN VALUE HERE IS EDIT-VALID, INCLUDING THREE DEPARTURES FROM THE SHIPPED ROW. ACUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED can only have been set by :1671-1675 on the previous turn, and only when no edit had set INPUT-ERROR, so a case that carried an edit-failing screen into a PF05 confirmation would be positing a state the program cannot reach. Three items of custdata.txt row 0 do fail their edits, and this case supplies valid ones in their place. FICO 274 fails the 88 FICO-RANGE-IS-VALID VALUES 300 THROUGH 850 at :848-849 that 1275-EDIT-FICO-SCORE tests at :2514, so ACSTFCOI carries 742. State NC with zip 12546 fails 1280-EDIT-US-STATE-ZIP-CD at :2536-2556, which STRINGs the two-character state onto the first two zip digits and looks the pair up in app/cpy/CSLKPCDY.cpy - a copybook that lists NC27 and NC28 and no other North Carolina prefix - so ACSZIPCI carries 27601. The second telephone's area code 373 does not occur in that copybook at all, so ACSPH2AI carries 919, which does; the first telephone's 908 is present and is kept unchanged. Everything else - status Y, the three dates, the names, both address lines, the city, USA, the three SSN parts, the government-issued id, the date of birth, the EFT account id and the primary-holder flag - is the shipped row echoed at its declared width.

THE FIVE INPUTS, AND WHAT EACH SHAPE IS FOR. These sites call NUMVAL-C rather than NUMVAL, and the difference is that NUMVAL-C accepts a currency sign and digit-grouping commas; the five values exercise five different points of its documented argument format, so no two of the five assertions can be satisfied by one code path. ACRDLIMI "$25,000.00" carries both a currency sign and a grouping comma, parses to 25000.00 and stores as 00000250000{. ACSHLIMI "5000.000" carries no sign, no currency sign and no comma, and its third decimal digit of 0 is what makes the store exact: 5000.00, stored as 00000050000{. ACURBALI "-1,234.50" carries a leading minus with a grouping comma and is the one site whose operand is the staging copy: -1234.50, stored as 00000012345} - note the } overpunch, a negative trailing zero, which is a different byte from the positive one. ACRCYCRI "+750.25" carries an explicit leading plus: 750.25, stored as 00000007502E, whose E is a positive 5 in the overpunch table. ACRCYDBI "0.00" is zero and stores as 00000000000{, a POSITIVE zero - a BigDecimal cannot hold the distinction between that and 00000000000}, which is exactly why the byte image is pinned alongside the value. All five arrive at their declared PIC X(15) width, right-space-padded, as the map delivers them.

HOW EACH SITE IS ASSERTED TWICE, OVER THE SAME TWELVE BYTES. The expectation names all five spans on both channels, in the two forms the differ accepts, so each REDEFINES pair is audited from both sides. On the WRITES channel each span is a decimal literal at scale exactly 2 - the -N numeric view - which is encoded into its canonical stored image through the same codec the implementation writes with before the bytes are compared. On the FINAL_STATE channel each span is the raw twelve-character zoned image including its overpunched sign byte - the PIC X(12) character view. Both channels additionally pin the complete record image, which is what makes the expectation cover every byte of the record rather than only the bytes it names: a span no expectation covers is a span that can be wrong while the diff count stays zero. ACCT-ID and CUST-ID are pinned on both channels as well, so no assertion is anchored to a row nobody identified.

THE MESSAGE THAT IS NOT THERE. :876 SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF establishes the entry state; 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS returns before composing anything and both rewrites succeed, so WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :479 still holds seventy-five spaces when COMMON-RETURN moves it into CCARD-ERROR-MSG at :1008. It is asserted as a present, blank, seventy-five-character line rather than as an absent message, because a cleared field and a field nobody wrote are different observations. The channel is DISPLAY_LINE because that field is neither the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE nor the 78-byte ERRMSGO the map carries, and only the variable-width channel can carry its 75.

GATES. G23 and G28 are OWNED here: every monetary value carries scale exactly 2 as PIC S9(10)V99 declares, and each of the five COMPUTE sites gets at least one targeted assertion, with five distinct input shapes so the five assertions are independent of one another. Also satisfied: G15, one of the twenty declarative cases this program owns; G17 and G18, the comparison is field by field and the diff count must be zero; G19 and G21, the account row is 300 bytes and the customer row 500, FILLER included and space-filled; G22 and G24, no binary floating-point value appears anywhere and the store truncates through RoundingMode.DOWN; G37, no server-side state - the AID, the commarea and every screen value travel in the payload; and G51, the unit kind is SERVICE, so account.AccountUpdateService is constructed with its collaborators and called as a plain object with no HTTP, no MockMvc and no JobLauncher in the path. NOT APPLICABLE, stated rather than left silent: G16, whose cardxref padding has no subject in this case, because the unit under test reads ACCTDAT and CUSTDAT under the lock and nothing else - no cardxref row is seeded, and a normalisation declared for a dataset a case does not seed is one that can never fire; G32, which covers CBSTM03A's backward loop-forming GO TOs and has no counterpart in COACTUPC; and G35, since COACTUPC contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' at all and this path reaches no abend.

EXPLICIT AT EVERY BOUNDARY. The code page is named US-ASCII rather than inherited from a platform default, the clock is pinned so nothing depends on the day the suite runs, every field map is ordered, and every width in this file traces to a PICTURE clause: PIC X(15) for the screen text, PIC X(12) for the span, PIC S9(10)V99 for the numeric view, PIC 9(11) for the account key, PIC 9(09) for the customer key and PIC X(75) for the return message. EIBCALEN is 1033 - 160 bytes of CARDDEMO-COMMAREA plus the 873-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA that COMMON-RETURN returns at :1010-1018 - so the left disjunct of the commarea gate at :880 is false, and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is spaces rather than COMEN01C so the right disjunct at :881-882 is false too: the ELSE at :887-892 restores both areas from DFHCOMMAREA and nothing is re-initialised.
